Type.evidence_source: School and work were consistently referenced by participants as crucial social spaces within which their marginality cascaded and their misfit identities (and oftentimes withdrawal) became entrenched.

Area.evidence_source: School and work also recursively connected to suicidality, wherein men's suicidality could negatively affect their academic and career outcomes, while school and work pressures also exacerbated some participants' suicidality. Typically, negative school experiences stalled men's advancement, affecting their work and career prospects.
